critical_code_review_comments: useFeatureGate.ts:36-39 — graceful default of `return true` for missing feature_ids is the correct call: when the ACM cache predates a new feature_id (e.g. older worker hasn't seen v2026-06-24-04 yet), the in-flow affordance still renders rather than mysteriously disappearing. The 'locked'/'hidden' codes are correctly treated as OFF.

CollabBar.tsx:36-37 — combining the caller's `hideShare/hideCall` prop with the ACM flag via boolean AND is correct; gives admin a hard kill-switch via ACM but lets individual screens still opt out per step.

atex.tsx:44-72 — openPicker uses Promise.allSettled (not Promise.all) so a 5xx from /ctt/tasks won't break /action-items results and vice-versa. Dedup keys on lower-cased trimmed title — correct for the typical 'same task added in both trackers' case. Empty-title entries are skipped via the early-return in `push`. Cleanup is fine.

atex.tsx:295-309 — picker empty-state copy still reads 'No tasks found in your Task Tracker yet.' which is now misleading when both /action-items and /ctt/tasks are empty (the user might not realize Action Tracker was even consulted). Consider rewording to 'No tasks found in your Action Tracker or Task Tracker yet.' so the empty state is honest about both sources.

(tabs)/index.tsx:94 — the Shared Inbox tile filter `if (id === 'inbox') return isFeatureOn('collab_shared_inbox')` is wired before other filters; good. Verified the hook fetches /acm/my-access once on mount and `isOn` is referentially-stable via useCallback so the tile filter doesn't re-render on every keystroke.

rca_of_issue: ATEX picker bug RCA: Prior implementation only queried GET /api/ctt/tasks (the project tracker). The admin's task data lives in /api/action-items (universal Action Tracker / inbox), so the picker rendered the 'No tasks found' empty state even though the user had 3+ entries. FIX (confirmed live, /app/frontend/app/tools/atex.tsx:44-72): openPicker now uses Promise.allSettled to fetch BOTH endpoints in parallel, normalises titles, dedupes by lower-cased title, and tags each row with _kind ('action' / 'ctt' / 'routine') so the leading icon switches accordingly (flag-outline for Action-Tracker, ellipse-outline for CTT, repeat for routine CTT). Selecting a row sets taskTitle to the row title and closes the modal — verified.
